title: ReGenesis: LLMs can Grow into Reasoning Generalists via Self-Improvement
authors_zh: Xiangyu Peng, Congying Xia, Xinyi Yang, Caiming Xiong, Chien-Sheng Wu, Chen Xing
paper_type_zh: 自生成推理轨迹构造与 SFT 配方
best_for_zh: 研究推理数据合成、答案筛选、自训练与跨任务泛化的读者
one_line: ReGenesis transforms 25 general reasoning guidelines into task-specific structures and answer-selected paths, retaining at most five trajectories per instruction for SFT.
ReGenesis 用 25 条通用推理准则逐层生成任务准则、结构与答案筛选轨迹，展示了跨任务自生成 SFT 配方，但终局匹配不能验证步骤且官方语料与代码尚未发布。
why: For the Data Construction track, it makes pre-trace planning objects and retry lineage explicit, while also showing why terminal-answer success, hidden upstream hints, and unreleased corpora require separate quality audits.
inclusion_reason: ReGenesis is a concrete reasoning-data construction recipe: it turns answer-keyed tasks into self-generated SFT trajectories through an explicit guideline-to-structure-to-path lineage, terminal selection, and answer-hinted recovery whose benefits and audit risks can be separately examined.

title: Problem
问题
html:
ReGenesis was published as an ICLR 2025 Oral paper. It asks a construction question: can a model create useful reasoning-path SFT data for itself from task instructions and final answers, without a stronger reasoning teacher or human-written task-specific demonstrations? The paper focuses on the poor out-of-domain transfer observed when prior self-improvement recipes directly sample task-specific chains of thought. It does not study online RL, learned process rewards, interactive environments, or human step annotation. (Paper §1–§3; ICLR proceedings record)

The source object is an answer-keyed training item (q_i, a_i). Main experiments draw training items separately from GSM8K, NumGLUE, ReClor, ARC-Challenge, and StrategyQA; GSM8K human rationales are deliberately excluded. ReGenesis expands each item through 25 fixed general reasoning guidelines into task-adapted guidelines, non-solving reasoning structures, complete paths, and predicted answers. A final SFT row contains the instruction, one selected complete path, and the reference answer; the paper does not state that adapted guidelines or structures are retained in the final target. (Paper §3.1, §4.1.1)

This belongs in Data Construction / Open Release Recipes because its central contribution is a trace-generation and selection lineage, not a new benchmark or verifier. The L4 boundary is asymmetric: the official paper, appendix, venue status, affiliation, prompts, experimental settings, and results are inspectable, but no official code, generated corpus, trained checkpoint, or method project release was verified. The Card can therefore reconstruct the disclosed recipe and its audit questions, but it cannot certify a reusable release or reproduce item-level lineage.

ReGenesis 是 ICLR 2025 Oral 论文。它研究一个数据构造问题：在没有更强推理教师或人工编写的任务特定示例时，模型能否只依赖任务指令与终局答案，为自身生成有用的推理路径 SFT 数据。论文针对既有自改进配方直接采样任务特定 chain-of-thought 后分布外迁移较差的问题；它不研究在线 RL、学习型过程奖励、交互环境或人工步骤标注。（论文 §1–§3；ICLR 官方论文集）

源数据对象是一条带答案的训练样本 (q_i, a_i)。主要实验分别使用 GSM8K、NumGLUE、ReClor、ARC-Challenge 与 StrategyQA 的训练数据，并特意排除 GSM8K 人工 rationale。ReGenesis 将每条样本与 25 条固定通用推理准则组合，依次生成任务特定准则、不直接求解任务的推理结构、完整路径与预测答案。最终 SFT 样本包含指令、一个筛选后的完整路径与参考答案；论文未说明任务准则或推理结构也会进入最终训练目标。（论文 §3.1、§4.1.1）

该工作归入 Data Construction / Open Release Recipes，因为核心贡献是轨迹生成与筛选 lineage，而不是新 benchmark 或 verifier。其 L4 证据边界并不对称：官方论文、附录、venue 状态、机构、提示词、实验设置与结果均可核验，但尚未核实官方代码、生成语料、训练 checkpoint 或方法项目页。因此本卡可以重建已披露配方及审计问题，却不能证明存在可直接复用的发布，也无法复核逐条样本 lineage。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution in one sentence is: use the target model to move from 25 task-agnostic reasoning guidelines to task-specific guidelines, then to non-solving structures, and finally to answer-selected complete paths that supervise the same model.

The construction object has four representational layers. A human-written seed guideline names a broad strategy such as decomposition or systems thinking. The model adapts that guideline to the current instruction, expands it into a structure that should organize but not solve the task, and then instantiates the structure as a step-by-step path plus predicted answer. The same target model produces all three generated layers. The selected training record is the complete path, not a separately labeled sequence of valid steps. (Figure 1; Paper §3.1)

The main feedback contract is terminal and programmatic: extract the predicted answer and compare it with the dataset reference answer. A passing answer makes the path eligible; up to five eligible paths are retained at random. The verifier observes final-answer agreement but cannot observe whether intermediate statements are valid, necessary, faithful to the model's computation, or free of answer-conditioned rationalization. The majority-vote alternative observes agreement among sampled answers, not correctness. (Paper §3.2, §5.2)

The closest self-training comparisons are LMSI and STaR. LMSI uses few-shot CoT examples and majority vote, with a ground-truth-filtered variant added by the authors; STaR directly samples chains of thought, filters by answers, and exposes hints during path generation for failed items. ReGenesis changes the pre-path representation and moves its retry hint upstream: only guideline adaptation and structure generation receive the answer, while final path generation does not. Self-Discover is a closer representation-level precursor because it composes reasoning structures, but ReGenesis turns the abstract-to-concrete chain into selected post-training data for the same model. The novelty is this construction interface and hint placement, not the individual ideas of CoT, answer filtering, self-consistency, or SFT.

一句话贡献是：让目标模型把 25 条任务无关推理准则逐步转成任务特定准则、不直接求解任务的结构与答案筛选后的完整路径，再用这些路径监督同一个模型。

构造对象包含四层表示。人工编写的 seed guideline 描述分解、systems thinking 等通用策略；模型先把准则适配到当前指令，再扩展成只组织思路而不求解任务的结构，最后把结构实例化为逐步路径与预测答案。三个生成层都来自同一个目标模型。最终训练记录是完整路径，并非带独立有效性标签的逐步序列。（Figure 1；论文 §3.1）

主要 feedback contract 是终局、程序化判定：抽取预测答案并与数据集参考答案比较。答案通过后路径才具备候选资格，再随机保留至多五条。该 verifier 能观察终局答案一致性，却不能观察中间陈述是否有效、必要、忠实反映模型计算过程，或是否受到答案条件诱导而形成事后合理化。majority-vote 备选只观察采样答案间的一致性，并不直接观察正确性。（论文 §3.2、§5.2）

最接近的自训练对照是 LMSI 与 STaR。LMSI 使用 few-shot CoT 示例和 majority vote，作者还实现了 ground-truth 过滤变体；STaR 直接采样 chain-of-thought，按答案筛选，并在失败样本的路径生成阶段暴露 hint。ReGenesis 改变的是路径生成前的表示，并把重试 hint 上移：只有 guideline adaptation 与 structure generation 接收答案，最终路径生成不接收。Self-Discover 是更接近的表示层先行工作，因为它也组合 reasoning structure，但 ReGenesis 将相似的抽象到具体过程转成同一模型的筛选式后训练数据。新意在于这一构造接口与 hint 位置，而非单独发明 CoT、答案过滤、self-consistency 或 SFT。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs. Start with a model M, a training split of instruction/reference-answer pairs (q_i, a_i), and 25 fixed general reasoning guidelines listed in Appendix A.4.1. The main model is Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3. Five datasets are processed separately: GSM8K and NumGLUE for mathematics, ReClor for logic, and ARC-Challenge plus StrategyQA for commonsense. GSM8K contributes numerical answers but not its human rationales. Exact dataset revisions and item identifiers are not disclosed. (Paper §3, §4.1.1)

Generation. For every instruction and every seed guideline, the same model first writes a task-adapted guideline. It then writes one detailed reasoning structure that should not solve the task, and finally expands that structure into a complete reasoning path and predicted answer. Main generation uses temperature 0.85, producing 25 candidates per instruction. This is a fixed-width sampling scaffold rather than search over a tree. (Paper §3.1, §4.1.2)

Terminal selection. Main experiments extract each predicted answer and apply exact match to the reference answer. Paths that fail are discarded. If an instruction has no passing path, the pipeline retries after supplying the reference answer only during guideline adaptation and structure generation; the final path-generation prompt does not contain the answer. This design reduces direct answer exposure compared with STaR, but the intermediate objects may still encode answer-specific information. Table 1 reports that the retry raises mean instruction coverage from 96.2% to 99.4% across the five training sets. From the passing pool, the recipe randomly keeps at most p=5 paths per instruction. (Paper §3.2, Table 1; Appendix A.1)

Alternative selector. For datasets without reference answers, the paper studies self-consistency: sampled answers vote and paths supporting the majority answer are selected. This experiment covers GSM8K and StrategyQA, despite both having references, and therefore demonstrates an alternative mechanism rather than validating truly unlabeled deployment. Majority agreement is not an independent correctness judgment. (Paper §5.2, Table 5)

Output and training. The disclosed SFT tuple is (q_i, r_path_i,j, a_i). Main Mistral training uses learning rate 1e-6, 3 epochs, batch size 16, weight decay 0.1, cosine scheduling, warmup ratio 0.03, and an 8-A100 node with 40 GB per GPU. Appendix A.5.4 gives the same optimizer settings. The Llama analysis uses vLLM for data creation and LoRA SFT with learning rate 1e-4, 3 epochs, batch size 8, weight decay 0.1, cosine scheduling, and warmup ratio 0.1. (Paper §4.1.2; Appendix Tables 21–22)

Evaluation. Fine-tuned models are tested on the corresponding in-domain test split and six OOD datasets: ASDiv, SVAMP, AQuA, BBH, ANLI, and OpenBookQA. Exact-match accuracy is used throughout. Inference CoT uses temperature 0.8; self-consistency draws 15 responses at temperature 0.8 and majority-votes the final answer. Appendix A.2 holds total mixed-training size at 7,000 while combining two, three, or four training datasets, with three random seeds per combination. (Paper §4.1.4, §4.3; Appendix A.2, A.6.1)

Reproduction boundary. A faithful reconstruction must pin source-dataset versions and split IDs, the exact 25 prompts and system templates, answer extractors, retry flags, generation seeds, maximum lengths, random-retention seeds, model revisions, and SFT implementation. The paper supplies prompt text and optimizer hyperparameters, but not immutable source snapshots, per-item construction records, total token/compute budgets, retry counts, or released scripts. No official implementation or generated dataset was verified.

输入。 从模型 M、训练集中的指令—参考答案对 (q_i, a_i) 以及 Appendix A.4.1 列出的 25 条固定通用推理准则开始。主要模型为 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3。五个数据集分别处理：数学使用 GSM8K 与 NumGLUE，逻辑使用 ReClor，常识使用 ARC-Challenge 与 StrategyQA。GSM8K 只提供数值答案，不使用人工 rationale。论文未披露精确数据版本与样本编号。（论文 §3、§4.1.1）

生成。 对每条指令与每条 seed guideline，同一模型先写出任务特定准则，再生成一个不应直接求解任务的详细推理结构，最后扩展为完整推理路径与预测答案。主流程以 temperature 0.85 为每条指令产生 25 个候选。这是固定宽度采样脚手架，不是树搜索。（论文 §3.1、§4.1.2）

终局筛选。 主实验抽取每个预测答案，并与参考答案做 exact match；不通过的路径被丢弃。若某条指令没有任何通过路径，则把参考答案只提供给 guideline adaptation 与 structure generation 后重试，最终路径生成 prompt 不含答案。相较 STaR，这减少了直接答案暴露，但中间对象仍可能携带答案特定信息。Table 1 显示，该重试将五个训练集的平均指令覆盖率从 96.2% 提高到 99.4%。随后从通过池中随机保留至多 p=5 条路径。（论文 §3.2、Table 1；Appendix A.1）

备选筛选器。 对没有参考答案的数据，论文研究 self-consistency：由采样答案投票，并选择支持多数答案的路径。该实验实际覆盖有参考答案的 GSM8K 与 StrategyQA，因此展示的是备选机制，而非真正无标签场景的验证。多数一致也不是独立正确性判断。（论文 §5.2、Table 5）

输出与训练。 已披露的 SFT tuple 为 (q_i, r_path_i,j, a_i)。Mistral 主实验使用学习率 1e-6、3 epochs、batch size 16、weight decay 0.1、cosine scheduler、warmup ratio 0.03，以及 8 张 40GB A100；Appendix A.5.4 给出相同优化设置。Llama 分析用 vLLM 构造数据，再以 LoRA SFT，设置为学习率 1e-4、3 epochs、batch size 8、weight decay 0.1、cosine scheduler 与 warmup ratio 0.1。（论文 §4.1.2；Appendix Tables 21–22）

评测。 微调模型在对应域内测试集与六个 OOD 数据集 ASDiv、SVAMP、AQuA、BBH、ANLI、OpenBookQA 上评估，全部使用 exact-match accuracy。推理时 CoT temperature 为 0.8；self-consistency 在 temperature 0.8 下采样 15 个回答并对最终答案投票。Appendix A.2 在总训练规模固定为 7,000 时混合两个、三个或四个训练集，每种组合使用三个随机种子。（论文 §4.1.4、§4.3；Appendix A.2、A.6.1）

复现边界。 忠实复现必须固定源数据版本与 split ID、25 条 prompt 及系统模板、答案抽取器、重试标记、生成随机种子、最大长度、随机保留种子、模型 revision 与 SFT 实现。论文公开了 prompt 文本与优化超参数，但没有不可变源快照、逐样本构造记录、总 token/算力预算、重试次数或发布脚本；目前也未核实官方实现或生成数据集。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence is a set of controlled accuracy comparisons under stated models and inference prompts. These are author-reported results; no independent reproduction or public corpus audit was verified.

  • In-domain utility. With Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 and self-consistency inference, the unfine-tuned model scores 60.0, 38.2, 80.6, 56.2, and 80.8 on GSM8K, NumGLUE, ARC-Challenge, ReClor, and StrategyQA. ReGenesis scores 76.6, 74.7, 85.4, 70.6, and 91.3, an average absolute gain of 16.56 percentage points. STaR scores 66.0, 64.5, 84.1, 63.8, and 85.9 under the same evaluation column. (Table 2)
  • OOD utility. For models fine-tuned separately on each of the five source datasets and evaluated on ASDiv, SVAMP, AQuA, BBH, ANLI, and OpenBookQA, the authors aggregate ReGenesis at about +6.1 percentage points relative to the unfine-tuned model; compared methods average about -4.6 points. The direction is not universal at every cell: NumGLUE-trained ReGenesis falls from 77.2 to 76.9 on ASDiv, and ReClor-trained ReGenesis falls from 77.2 to 76.4 on ASDiv, while most reported cells improve. (Paper §4.3, Table 3)
  • Component ablation. After GSM8K training, the complete adaptation + structure + path pipeline scores 76.6 in-domain and 81.2/83.9/48.8/69.3/49.5/81.4 on the six OOD tests. Removing structure yields 66.2 and 76.1/80.3/47.6/53.4/42.1/75.6; removing adaptation yields 70.0 and 77.5/80.1/47.2/57.9/43.0/76.4. (Table 4)
  • Selection without reference answers. Majority-filter ReGenesis scores 62.8 on GSM8K and 83.1 on StrategyQA, versus LMSI at 62.3/79.0 and the unfine-tuned model at 56.3/80.8. This is evidence that the scaffold can operate with agreement-based selection, but it covers two tasks and is below the main ground-truth-filter ReGenesis results of 76.6/91.3. (Tables 2 and 5)
  • Model transfer. On 10,000 NumGLUE examples, Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct rises from 58.9 to 79.2 in-domain; STaR reaches 75.6. The authors report a 6.46-point mean gain across the six OOD tasks. (Paper §5.3, Table 6)
  • Hint placement. When hints are given to all GSM8K training items, supplying them only at adaptation and structure stages scores 75.7 in-domain and beats supplying them at all three stages on five of six OOD tests; the respective vectors are 79.3/79.7/50.0/67.3/41.9/77.4 and 78.8/78.4/44.1/69.0/41.3/77.0. This supports withholding the answer from final path generation, but it does not isolate the main pipeline's failed-item-only retry. (Appendix Table 7)

The experiments establish downstream utility under these datasets and budgets. They do not establish that every selected path is stepwise valid, that the 25 guidelines cause transfer independently of selection and sample count, or that the unavailable generated corpus has auditable lineage.

最强证据是在明确模型与推理 prompt 下进行的一组受控准确率比较。以下均为作者报告结果；目前未核实独立复现或公开语料审计。

  • 域内效用。 使用 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 与 self-consistency 推理时，未微调模型在 GSM8K、NumGLUE、ARC-Challenge、ReClor、StrategyQA 上分别为 60.0、38.2、80.6、56.2、80.8；ReGenesis 为 76.6、74.7、85.4、70.6、91.3，平均绝对提升 16.56 个百分点。相同评测列下，STaR 为 66.0、64.5、84.1、63.8、85.9。（Table 2）
  • OOD 效用。 模型分别在五个源数据集上微调，再到 ASDiv、SVAMP、AQuA、BBH、ANLI 与 OpenBookQA 评测；作者汇总 ReGenesis 相对未微调模型约提升 6.1 个百分点，而对照方法平均约下降 4.6 个百分点。并非每个单元格都提升：NumGLUE 训练的 ReGenesis 在 ASDiv 上从 77.2 降到 76.9，ReClor 训练时从 77.2 降到 76.4，但大多数报告单元格改善。（论文 §4.3、Table 3）
  • 组件消融。 在 GSM8K 训练后，完整 adaptation + structure + path 流程域内得分 76.6，六个 OOD 得分为 81.2/83.9/48.8/69.3/49.5/81.4。移除 structure 时为 66.2 与 76.1/80.3/47.6/53.4/42.1/75.6；移除 adaptation 时为 70.0 与 77.5/80.1/47.2/57.9/43.0/76.4。（Table 4）
  • 无参考答案筛选。 majority-filter ReGenesis 在 GSM8K 与 StrategyQA 上为 62.8、83.1，LMSI 为 62.3、79.0，未微调模型为 56.3、80.8。这说明脚手架可以配合一致性筛选，但只覆盖两个任务，且低于主 ground-truth 筛选的 76.6、91.3。（Tables 2、5）
  • 模型迁移。 使用 10,000 条 NumGLUE 样本时，Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct 域内从 58.9 升至 79.2，STaR 为 75.6；作者报告六个 OOD 任务平均提升 6.46 个百分点。（论文 §5.3、Table 6）
  • Hint 位置。 当全部 GSM8K 训练样本都获得 hint 时，仅在 adaptation 与 structure 阶段提供答案的域内得分为 75.7，并在六个 OOD 中五项优于三个阶段都提供答案；两组 OOD 向量分别为 79.3/79.7/50.0/67.3/41.9/77.4 与 78.8/78.4/44.1/69.0/41.3/77.0。这支持最终路径生成不见答案，但没有隔离主流程中只对失败项重试的效果。（Appendix Table 7）

这些实验说明该配方在给定数据集与预算下具有下游效用；它们不能证明每条筛选路径都逐步有效，也不能单独把迁移归因于 25 条准则，更不能替代对未发布生成语料的 lineage 审计。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior self-improvement baselines already generated chains of thought, filtered candidates by reference answers or majority votes, and fine-tuned the same model. STaR also retried failed instructions with answer hints. ReGenesis does not introduce those components in isolation.

What changes is the representation before a complete path exists. Each task is crossed with 25 general reasoning guidelines; the model must adapt one guideline to the instruction and produce a non-solving structure before writing the path. This exposes two construction intermediates that direct CoT sampling leaves implicit. The method also places retry hints at those two upstream stages rather than in final path generation, creating a testable lineage distinction between freely generated and answer-conditioned examples.

The paper's comparisons support this distinction, with the full adaptation + structure + path pipeline outperforming either component-removal variant across the seven Table 4 tests, and upstream-only hinting outperforming all-stage hinting on six of seven Appendix Table 7 tests. These results make the abstraction ladder a plausible construction variable. They do not prove that the generated structures are faithful plans, because the same model creates and evaluates their downstream utility and no independent structure labels exist.

Self-Discover is a close representational antecedent: it composes task-specific reasoning structures from general modules. ReGenesis connects a related abstract-to-concrete idea to self-generated post-training records for the same target model. The claimed strategy-diversity evidence in Appendix A.8.2 is weaker than the accuracy ablations because Mistral itself labels and clusters 500 ReGenesis and 500 STaR paths. Before reuse, a curator should independently label strategy, validity, and redundancy while preserving guideline IDs, hint flags, and rejected paths.

既有自改进方法已经会生成 chain-of-thought、按参考答案或 majority vote 筛选候选，并用结果微调同一模型；STaR 也会对失败指令使用答案 hint 重试。ReGenesis 并未单独发明这些组件。

真正改变的是完整路径产生之前的表示。每个任务与 25 条通用推理准则组合，模型必须先把准则适配到指令，再写出不直接求解任务的结构，然后才能生成路径。由此，直接 CoT 采样中隐含的两个构造中间对象被显式化。方法还把重试 hint 放在这两个上游阶段，而不是最终路径生成阶段，从 lineage 上区分自由生成样本与答案条件样本。

论文比较支持这一差异：完整 adaptation + structure + path 流程在 Table 4 的七项评测上都超过两个移除组件的变体；上游阶段 hint 在 Appendix Table 7 的七项评测中六项超过全阶段 hint。因此，抽象阶梯是一个可信的构造变量。不过，这不能证明生成结构就是忠实计划，因为所有结构仍由同一模型产生，且不存在独立结构标签。

Self-Discover 是较接近的表示层先行工作：它从通用模块组合任务特定 reasoning structure。ReGenesis 把相似的抽象到具体思想连接到同一目标模型的自生成后训练记录。Appendix A.8.2 的策略多样性证据弱于准确率消融，因为 Mistral 自身为 500 条 ReGenesis 与 500 条 STaR 路径标注并聚类。复用前应由独立标注者审查策略、有效性与冗余，并保留 guideline ID、hint flag 与被拒路径。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Feedback limitation. Exact final-answer agreement is an outcome check, not a process label. It can accept an invalid intermediate claim that happens to reach the expected answer and reject an equivalent answer whose formatting defeats extraction. The paper's own Figure 1 worked path says that working 10 hours past an 8-hour limit means “2 shifts,” yet continues to the correct wage; this illustrates the gap between terminal success and step validity. Majority vote replaces reference truth with sample agreement and can reinforce correlated errors.

Hint and self-generation limitation. The main retry withholds the answer from final path generation, but adapted guidelines and structures were generated with the answer and can carry answer-specific constraints into the path. Curator inference: this reduces direct leakage relative to STaR but does not eliminate post-hoc rationalization. Because the same model generates every intermediate object, systematic misconceptions and stylistic artifacts can propagate through the whole pipeline.

Selection and data limitation. Randomly retaining at most five passing paths does not explicitly optimize semantic diversity, minimality, factual correctness, or coverage. Failed paths, rejection reasons, per-path verifier outputs, and whether a record came from the hinted retry are not available in a verified release. Table 1 measures whether an instruction has at least one answer-correct path, not the fraction or quality distribution of all 25 paths.

Experimental limitation. The main results use five established answer-keyed training datasets and exact-match evaluation. OOD tasks remain adjacent academic reasoning benchmarks, and per-cell gains are not universal. The diversity analysis changes dataset composition within a fixed 7,000 examples but does not establish causal transfer to open-ended tasks. The strategy-clustering analysis uses Mistral as both generator-related model and judge, with no human agreement or external diversity metric.

Reproducibility and governance limitation. No official code, generated corpus, checkpoint, or method-specific project release was verified. Exact dataset revisions, item identifiers, decontamination checks, answer extractors, random seeds, sequence limits, total generation tokens, retry counts, and corpus license are unknown. OpenReview's CC BY 4.0 applies to the paper record, not automatically to derived data from five datasets and two model families. Benchmark performance cannot resolve these release and provenance risks.

反馈限制。 终局答案 exact match 是结果检查，不是过程标签。它可能接受中间陈述错误但偶然得到期望答案的路径，也可能因抽取格式拒绝语义等价答案。论文 Figure 1 自己的正确答案示例写道，工作 10 小时超过 8 小时限制意味着“2 shifts”，随后却继续算出正确工资；这正说明终局成功与步骤有效性不同。majority vote 又把参考真值替换为采样一致性，可能放大相关错误。

Hint 与自生成限制。 主重试不在最终路径阶段给答案，但任务准则与推理结构是在答案条件下生成，仍可把答案特定约束带入路径。策展者推断：这相较 STaR 减少直接泄漏，却不能消除事后合理化。由于每个中间对象都由同一模型生成，系统性误解与风格伪迹可能贯穿完整流程。

筛选与数据限制。 在通过路径中随机保留至多五条，并不显式优化语义多样性、简洁性、事实正确性或覆盖度。目前没有核实到包含失败路径、淘汰原因、逐路径 verifier 输出或 hinted-retry 标志的官方发布。Table 1 测量的是一条指令是否至少有一个答案正确路径，而不是全部 25 条路径的正确率或质量分布。

实验限制。 主结果使用五个已有带答案训练集和 exact-match 评测；OOD 任务仍是相邻的学术推理 benchmark，而且并非每个单元格都提升。多样性分析在总数固定为 7,000 时改变数据集组合，但不足以建立对开放任务迁移的因果结论。策略聚类又让 Mistral 同时充当与生成器相关的模型和 judge，没有人工一致性或外部多样性指标。

复现与治理限制。 尚未核实官方代码、生成语料、checkpoint 或方法项目发布。精确数据版本、样本编号、去污染检查、答案抽取器、随机种子、序列上限、总生成 token、重试次数与语料许可证均 unknown。OpenReview 的 CC BY 4.0 适用于论文记录，不会自动覆盖五个数据集和两个模型家族产生的衍生数据。benchmark 提升不能消除这些发布与来源风险。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction / Open Release Recipes track, ReGenesis is most useful as a recipe and audit reference, not as a training release.

  • Reconstruct the abstraction ladder and compare direct CoT sampling against guideline adaptation plus structure generation while matching candidate count, accepted-row count, and SFT budget.
  • Store guideline ID, adapted guideline, structure, path, predicted answer, extracted answer, terminal verdict, hint flag, and retention decision as separate fields; the paper's conceptual lineage is richer than the final SFT tuple.
  • Audit terminal-filter false positives by independently checking intermediate steps in freely generated and answer-hinted strata, rather than treating downstream benchmark gains as path-quality labels.
  • Replace random retention with diversity-aware or validity-aware selection, then report how the accepted mixture and downstream transfer change.
  • Reproduce the majority-vote condition as a negative-control surface: measure when agreement diverges from reference correctness and whether correlated errors concentrate by guideline.
  • Use Appendix A.2's fixed-size mixture design to test whether domain diversity helps after controlling source versions, item overlap, and sampling seeds.

Reuse class: reading/audit reference only; training reuse is blocked pending verification. The method can be implemented from the paper, but no official generated paths, implementation, license, or immutable source snapshot was verified. Any independently recreated corpus should document its own provenance and should not be represented as the authors' release.

对 Data Construction / Open Release Recipes 方向而言，ReGenesis 最适合作为配方与审计参考，而不是可直接使用的训练发布。

  • 重建抽象阶梯，在候选数、接收样本数与 SFT 预算一致时，比较直接 CoT 采样和 guideline adaptation + structure generation。
  • 把 guideline ID、任务准则、结构、路径、预测答案、抽取答案、终局判定、hint flag 与保留决策分别存成字段；论文的概念 lineage 比最终 SFT tuple 更丰富。
  • 对自由生成与答案提示两个分层独立检查中间步骤，估计终局筛选假阳性，而不是把下游 benchmark 提升当成路径质量标签。
  • 用多样性感知或有效性感知选择替代随机保留，并同时报告接收数据组成与下游迁移如何变化。
  • 把 majority-vote 条件作为负对照，测量一致性何时偏离参考正确性，以及相关错误是否集中在特定 guideline。
  • 使用 Appendix A.2 的定规模混合设计，在控制源版本、样本重叠与采样种子后检验领域多样性的作用。

复用等级：仅适合作为阅读/审计参考；训练复用在完成核验前受阻。论文足以支持独立实现，但目前未核实官方生成路径、实现、许可证或不可变源快照。任何自行重建的语料都应记录自身 provenance，也不能表述为作者官方发布。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Figure 1 and §3.1 first: the important object is the lineage from a general guideline through an adapted guideline and non-solving structure to a complete path, not merely “synthetic CoT.”
  • Keep the feedback boundary precise: main filtering checks only the final answer; failed items receive the answer during adaptation and structure generation, never directly in the final path prompt.
  • Use Tables 2–4 for utility and ablation, but inspect negative cells in Table 3; the reported +6.1-point OOD result is an aggregate, not a universal gain.
  • Read Appendix A.1 and A.8.2 critically: hint-position evidence uses hints for every GSM8K item, and strategy diversity is judged and clustered by Mistral itself.
  • Pair with STaR, LMSI, and Self-Discover; still unknown are official code/data/checkpoints, source revisions, item-level lineage, decontamination, generation budget, and derived-data licensing.

• 先读 Figure 1 与 §3.1：关键对象是从通用 guideline 经任务准则和非求解结构到完整路径的 lineage，而不只是“synthetic CoT”。
  • 准确把握反馈边界：主筛选只检查最终答案；失败样本的答案用于 adaptation 与 structure generation，不会直接进入最终路径 prompt。
  • 用 Tables 2–4 判断效用与组件作用，同时检查 Table 3 的负向单元格；OOD 平均提升 6.1 个百分点并非每项都提升。
  • 批判性阅读 Appendix A.1 与 A.8.2：hint 位置实验对全部 GSM8K 样本加 hint，策略多样性则由 Mistral 自己标注和聚类。
  • 建议与 STaR、LMSI、Self-Discover 对读；仍未知官方代码/数据/checkpoint、源版本、逐样本 lineage、去污染、生成预算与衍生数据许可。
